# Glaze remnant handling

Close each remaining pot with its own fitted lid, leave the existing identifier attached, and move it to the remnant shelf on a washable tray. Record a remnant movement on the shift sheet. Do not return liquid to an unopened master container.

A pot with unreadable identity, foreign solids or an uncertain lid is isolated in the discard-review tray; it is never guessed back into a family. The materials keeper decides discard disposition on the review ticket. The [trace map](../records/trace-map.md#pot-identities) defines identifier records separately; this sheet specifies physical handling only.
